method: Viewed all 16 source microtiles and generated natives; inspected four full seam sheets and unscaled object crops offline. No in-game review.

objects.west-r1-c1-floor-shrub-02: visually removed landing bush; paving continuous in inspected crop

r1-c1.seamReview: No obvious rectangular quadrant boundary in inspected seam sheet. Fine independently drawn rock/ice textures differ near cuts; confirm at 100% in lossless export.

objects.west-r1-c3-floor-shrub-02: visually removed isolated shrub/small fir on front rim in assembled crop

r1-c3.seamReview: No obvious rectangular quadrant boundary in inspected seam sheet or object crop; fine paving detail varies across cut. Original upper ridge tree retained.

objects.west-r1-c4-floor-shrub-01: visually removed low shrub to right of stair on front plaza rim

r1-c4.seamReview: No obvious rectangular quadrant boundary in inspected seam sheet. Horizontal cut is near bridge rail/deck; check curved deck and animation-mask banks at final assembly.

notes: Local patch and affine residual diagnostics do not certify complete contours, bridge thickness, stair counts or liquid masks.
Cross-chunk edges deliberately left for ASSEMBLE.
JPEGs are space-saving review previews. Use lossless native and 2x WebP for fine detail decisions.
